local_not_served.title: Restart Home Assistant once to finish installing the BRUH Print card
local_not_served.description:
The card is installed, but Home Assistant is not serving it yet.

Home Assistant only serves the `/config/www` folder if that folder was already there when it started, and BRUH Print has just created it. Until Home Assistant restarts, a dashboard using the card shows "Custom element doesn't exist: bruh-print-card".

Restart Home Assistant once — Settings > System, then Restart at the top right — and the card appears. You will not have to do this again.
